nodes.label: Nosecone Cap CAD Model (Closeup/Detail View)
nodes.description: Close-up CAD view of the nosecone cap block component in Fusion 360 (file 'GMPR-draft_copy'). The component appears as a rectangular/trapezoidal solid block with a beveled or chamfered bottom edge. The geometry suggests this is a structural retaining cap or plug for the nosecone tip. The mesh/grid texture hints at a lightweight or patterned internal structure.
